canada.title: Film seeks to highlight work to document French cave where soldiers stayed
canada.summary: Last September, men in uniforms dating back to the First World War descended the narrow and slippery steps in the dark to visit Maison Blanche souteraine in northern France. It’s part of a documentary highlighting the work of non-profit Canadigm.

canada.title: Saskatoon judge delivers 20-year sentence for ‘absolutely abhorrent’ killing
canada.summary: One of the three people responsible for a gruesome 2024 Saskatoon homicide has been sentenced to 20 years behind bars on charges of manslaughter and indignity to human remains.

canada.title: People to gather in Winnipeg for Manitoba's largest Remembrance Day ceremony
canada.summary: People are gathering in Winnipeg on Wednesday for a Remembrance Day ceremony at the RBC Convention Centre.

canada.title: Parts of B.C. could be without power for days as storm continues to batter province
canada.summary: B.C. Hydro is warning that some drenched areas of the province could be without power for days, as a fall storm continued to make its presence felt on Wednesday.

canada.title: Canadians gather for Remembrance Day ceremonies across the country
canada.summary: Canadians across the country are gathering today to reflect on the legacy of war and remember the men and women who served and died defending this country.

canada.title: Fresh Prep approved to purchase Montreal-based competitor Goodfood
canada.summary: Fresh Prep refused to disclose how much it will pay for Goodfood but says the deal is expected to close on or around Friday.

canada.title: Polish woman shares harrowing WW II story with Sask. community
canada.summary: Decades after rebuilding their lives in Saskatchewan, Polish survivors are working to ensure those experiences are never forgotten.

canada.title: Crowchild Trail partially closed from Marda Loop to 17th Avenue S.W. after rollover crash
canada.summary: Police have blocked off a section of Crowchild Trail as they investigate a collision in southwest Calgary.

canada.title: Brampton plant sale leaves Stellantis workers in Windsor questioning their own job security
canada.summary: A former employee of the Stellantis Brampton Assembly plant who currently works at the Windsor plant says the planned sale of the Brampton facility is devastating.

canada.title: Remembrance Day ceremony will honour CFB Wainwright fire victims
canada.summary: Four soldiers killed in a fire during a training exercise at CFB Wainwright will be honoured at a community Remembrance Day ceremony Wednesday.

canada.title: As veterans are remembered, some Legion branches hope to see more from young members
canada.summary: As Canadian families honour those they lost to war, some Royal Canadian Legion branches are welcoming a new wave of members and hope they get more involved.

canada.title: N.W.T. sports review highlights uneven playing field for small communities
canada.summary: A review of the N.W.T.'s participation in large, multisport events has found that many survey respondents believe athletes from outside Yellowknife aren’t getting an equal shot at competing on the big stage.

canada.title: What's open, closed around Halifax for Remembrance Day
canada.summary: Under Nova Scotia's Remembrance Day Act, some retail businesses must be closed Nov. 11, including malls, big-box stores and grocery stores.

canada.title: Ukrainian war veteran from Manitoba's Interlake walks the walk in fundraising campaign
canada.summary: Ukrainian war veteran Peter Derksen has completed a nearly six-month and over 4,000 kilometre hike on the Pacific Crest Trail, travelling on foot from the U.S.-Mexico border to Canada as part of a personal fundraising campaign for the ongoing war effort.

canada.title: N.B. veteran to wear replica medals on Remembrance Day after originals were stolen
canada.summary: A 91-year-old New Brunswick veteran thought he might have to spend this Remembrance Day without his medals after his were stolen from his home this summer. But that won't be the case for retired lieutenant-colonel Alan Kennedy. While they aren't the originals, the replicas, made possible because of the effort of a fellow veteran and kindness of a local businesswoman, will be pinned over his heart on Nov. 11.

canada.title: When Moncton was a hub for Allied Forces air crew training
canada.summary: The Moncton servicemen’s centre was established by the Canadian Jewish Congress to provide a welcoming and comfortable space for people of any faith who had been deployed to the area for military training.

canada.title: Website saves Royal Canadian Navy history from being 'buried forever'
canada.summary: Garry Weir's genealogy website began with a small section helping people find military records for loved ones. It has since morphed into a sprawling archive dedicated to Royal Canadian Navy history.

canada.title: Parks Canada to shut down 3 northern warden detachments, centralize in Yellowknife
canada.summary: Kluane National Park and Reserve in Yukon, Nahanni National Park Reserve in N.W.T., and Wood Buffalo National Park in N.W.T. and Alberta will lose their detachments.
